checks: The already proved normal-subgroup projective semilinear Aut(S) models give faithful F_p representations of dimension O(log|S|): conjugation/field action on the full matrix algebra is faithful and induction across bounded graph index preserves faithfulness in every characteristic.

A centerless nonabelian socle has trivial centralizer in the finite group, hence conjugation embeds the group in the product of Aut(S) wreath permutation groups. Block-permutation representations have dimension bounded by the sum of logarithmic simple orders.

Known Maróti1.1 gives a quasipolynomial order bound except alternating-product and four fixed Mathieu actions. In the alternating-product case, factor-orbit products are minimal normal subgroups; all alternating simple factors therefore belong to the stipulated finite collection, bounding m.
The resulting intrinsic faithful dimension is O((1+logN)^2), so the existing exact subgroup/stabilizer enumeration gives exp(O((1+logN)^8)) local types and retains the factorial global conclusions.
No alternating/Lie isomorphism classification is assumed: the unbounded family explicitly excludes alternating isomorphism types, while any finite exceptions are separately allowed.
